full_prompt_en: A square cinematic interior image looks down a dim corridor toward a doorway glowing orange at the far end. The hall is enclosed by dark walls and a low shadowed ceiling, with few details visible beyond faint doorframes and a small ceiling fixture. On the left, a narrow side window or opening glows cool cyan, washing the nearby wall with a soft blue-green edge. At the center distance, the rectangular doorway is the main source of warmth. Orange light fills its opening and diffuses into the hazy air just outside it, leaving no clearly visible room beyond. On the right, several dark chairs or tall furnishings cluster against the wall, their outlines only partly readable. A small rectangular shade rises among them. The tiled floor begins almost black in the foreground and runs toward the orange opening. Damp or polished patches catch a subdued vertical amber reflection along the central tiles, while the side edges remain swallowed by shadow. The competing light sources do not flood the room: each forms a local colored zone, and the rest of the corridor stays deep charcoal, teal, and brown. Fine haze softens the transitions around the bright openings, so the glow feels suspended in the air rather than painted as a hard-edged beam. No people or readable text appear. The low viewpoint and converging floor lines pull attention steadily toward the distant door. The overall composition is spare and atmospheric, balancing a small warm destination against a cooler side accent and a large enclosing area of darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影感室内影像沿昏暗走廊望向尽头发橙光的门洞。走廊被深墙与低暗天花板围合，除了淡淡门框与一个小顶灯装置，几乎没有别的细节可辨。左侧一道狭窄侧窗或开口泛冷青色光，在附近墙面铺出柔软蓝绿色边缘。中央远处矩形门洞是主要暖光源。橙光充满开口，并向其外侧的朦胧空气扩散，门后房间仍不可清楚看见。右侧几把深色椅子或高家具靠墙聚着，轮廓只能部分读出，其间有一个小矩形罩体向上伸出。铺砖地板从近乎黑色的前景开始，通向橙色开口。潮湿或抛光处沿中央地砖接住克制的竖向琥珀倒影，两侧边缘被暗影吞没。两处光源都没有灌满房间：各自形成局部彩色区域，走廊其余部分仍是深炭色、青绿与棕色。细雾柔化明亮开口周围的过渡，使辉光像悬在空气中，而非画成硬边光束。没有人物或可读文字。低视点与汇聚的地面线条把注意力稳定拉向远门。整体构图简省且富空气感，以小小暖色目的地平衡较冷的侧面重点与大面积围合黑暗。
style_prompt_en: A diffuse cinematic lighting style lets compact warm and cool sources bloom into hazy air while most of the composition remains dark. Orange and amber gather in one distant area; cyan and teal mark a secondary side zone; charcoal and brown-black occupy the largest surfaces. Light gradients have soft, atmospheric edges instead of sharp projected rays. Nearby silhouettes remain partial, and distance is carried by converging floor or structural lines plus the gradual loss of detail. A low reflective surface catches a narrow warm streak without becoming uniformly glossy. The camera feels close to shadow, looking toward a small luminous opening. The overall effect is hushed, enclosed, and gently suspenseful, with color temperature and subdued floor reflection doing more than visible object detail.
style_prompt_zh: 漫射的电影感布光让紧凑暖冷光源在雾气中晕开，同时构图大部分保持深暗。橙与琥珀集中在远处一小块，青与蓝绿标出次级侧面区域，炭色和棕黑占据最大表面。光线渐层有柔软空气边缘，而非投出的清晰光束。近处剪影保持局部可辨，纵深由地面或结构汇聚线与细节渐失共同承载。低处反光表面接住一条狭窄暖痕，却不变成均匀镜面。镜头仿佛贴近阴影，望向小小亮口。整体低声、围合且含蓄紧张，色温与克制的地面倒影比可见物件细节承担更多表达。
theme_en: A dim corridor with an orange doorway and a cyan side window
theme_zh: 昏暗走廊尽头有橙色门光，侧面有青色窗光
name: Diffused lighting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
